title: Yoeleo G21 Altera - bombproof & Huge tyre clearance

takeaways.text: Size 56 (L) frame 1.32 kg, fork 420 g, integrated H21 bar 370 g, seatpost 189 g; supplied by Yoeleo with optional extras.

Headset bearings differ (8 mm lower red, 7 mm upper black), spacers are split for routing changes, and the manual lists torque values; compared with the old G21 the Altera has a slightly slacker head angle, wider fork, UDH, T47 instead of press-fit and a round post.
Repeats Yoeleo's 53 mm 700C or 650B×2.1 in clearance; 1× chainring up to 42T (44T with a longer spindle) or a 2× 50/34 with front derailleur.

Bottom bracket uses two separate bonded threaded aluminium inserts with spotless threads; SRAM cups threaded in by hand and a 0.127 mm feeler gauge would not enter under the flanges. Brake mounts and dropouts were clean.
In August 2025 the frameset came with a six-year standard warranty, extendable to lifetime for a fee; one stock colour (champagne) plus custom paint.

disclosure: The description carries the creator's Yoeleo discount codes; the video does not state how the frameset was obtained.
summary: Detailed frameset overview: weighed parts, mounts, storage, fork options, warranty, sizing, the owner's manual and thread preparation before the build.
